observation_summary: A unit test calls TimeSeries.createCopy(...) with start and end periods that map to no items in the series. Instead of returning an empty series, the code throws IllegalArgumentException "Requires start <= end." The stack trace points to the check that enforces start <= end, and the index-based path later should detect an empty range but did not because a missing condition allowed createCopy(startIndex, endIndex) to be invoked with endIndex < startIndex.
reasoning_summary: The fix (diff) adds an extra predicate to mark the computed index range as empty when endIndex < startIndex. This is clearly a missing/incorrect validation/guard: the code needed to detect an invalid/empty index range and avoid calling createCopy with swapped indices. The change is an addition to conditional logic (a guard), not a value assignment, algorithm rewrite, API change, concurrency fix, or structural design change—so it matches Checking.
evidence_used: fix_diff_oracle unified_diff: changed if (endIndex < 0) to if ((endIndex < 0) || (endIndex < startIndex)) — added missing condition to detect empty ranges
